description: Seed review queue for the editable SOP / HITL wiki prototype. Merged with localStorage proposals in the viewer.

proposals.old_text: Screen every bail matter for national security elements at intake. If NSL Art.42 may be engaged, flag the matter, apply the stricter threshold, and route through the senior partner gate before any client communication.
proposals.new_text: Screen every bail matter for national security elements at intake. If NSL Art.42 may be engaged, flag the matter, apply the stricter no-bail-unless threshold as construed by the CFA in HKSAR v Lai Chee Ying [2021] HKCFA 3, and route through the senior partner gate before any client communication.
proposals.note: Anchor the NSL screening block to the CFA construction of NSL Art.42(2).

changelog.note: Anchor the NSL screening block to the CFA construction of NSL Art.42(2).

proposals.old_text: Always identify the client's procedural posture (police bail, court bail, variation, revocation, bail pending appeal) before applying any bail principles. If facts are incomplete, produce an assumptions list and mark the advice as preliminary.
proposals.new_text: Always identify the client's procedural posture (police bail, court bail, variation, revocation, bail pending appeal) and whether the charge falls under ordinary Cap 221 bail or the NSL regime before applying any bail principles. If facts are incomplete, produce an assumptions list and mark the advice as preliminary.
proposals.note: Distinguish the two bail regimes at posture stage.

changelog.note: Distinguish the two bail regimes at posture stage.
Approved; consistent with firm bail bundle.
